card.name: Small words right after a number
card.fires_on: Short linking words or punctuation (a, in, is, should, (, –) placed directly after a number, year, or quantity at the start of a clause or phrase.

modes.label: Verb or article after a number
modes.description: A small word like is, a, or should follows a number or quantity and begins the statement about it.
modes.example: 14 days<< should>> elapse between discontinuation of an MA

modes.label: Bracket, dash, or 'in' after a figure
modes.description: Punctuation or 'in' follows a figure, giving a percentage, range, or unit.

modes.label: Word after a year
modes.description: A capitalized or short word follows a year, often starting a title.
modes.example: 1790<< First>> American Chart of the Gulf of Mexico

card.writes: Little clear effect; it promotes odd name-like word starts and suppresses digits and spaces.
card.plain: It fires on a small word that comes straight after a number, such as a year, count, or dose.
